subject: StickyInkToolbar: every pinned ink toolbar uses it (own compositing layer); SectionInk.tsx:89 must switch
body:
Contract (S12a, lead decision in re-review 2): every pinned ink toolbar uses StickyInkToolbar from apps/web/src/ink/InkToolbar.tsx. Nobody writes their own sticky wrapper around InkToolbar. import { StickyInkToolbar } from "../InkToolbar"; - Props: the InkToolbar props, plus placement ("top" | "bottom") and an optional wrapperClassName. - top = sticky top-[calc(var(--shell-top,0px)+8px)] z-10 - bottom = sticky bottom-[calc(var(--shell-bottom,0px)+12px)] z-10 - Both add will-change-transform. That is the point: without its own layer, WebKit repaints the whole scrolled page, ink pictures included, on every scroll frame (20-40 % of frame rate on webkit-laptop-1440). - The wrapper has data-sticky-ink-toolbar for tests. seg12b: apps/web/src/ink/persist/SectionInk.tsx:89 has
Replace it with (same classes, plus the layer). It lands in my next integrate. Tell me if you would rather I make the change in your file. Also from this change, the engine now: - parks settled slab pictures when a slab leaves the keep window, and shows them again without repainting - exposes renderStats.tilesPainted, repaints and slabsRestored - has startProbe()/stopProbe() for main-thread time Your applyRemote edits go through doc.onDirty, so they invalidate parked pictures (markDirtySu).
